description: Build machine, its "main" workspace; reviewers only. Plain http: the bearer token travels in clear text, so reach it over a VPN or a unix socket. Workspace layout: G/remotes/build-box.json is a binding (one server, one workspace) and holds no credential; the key file G/auth/keys/build-box.json supplies it once workspace.json (or a session or profile) lists it in remote_keys and the tool lists "build-box" in remotes. Address: remote:build-box/<session>/<category>/<profile>.
